articles.title: Fed seeks input on limited payment accounts after Trump order
articles.snippet: The US Federal Reserve proposed a limited “skinny” payment account framework for fintech and crypto firms and called for a temporary pause on Tier 3 applications.

articles.title: Trump Halts AI Order Over Fears It Could Hurt US Edge Over China
articles.snippet: Trump said he delayed the order because parts of the proposal risked slowing the U.S. AI industry as competition with China intensifies.

articles.title: Crypto Backing or Trump Pump? Fairshake PAC Claims Primary Victories
articles.snippet: Fairshake said six primary victories on Tuesday revealed a “powerful bipartisan mandate” for pro-crypto policies. But other factors appear to have been at play.

articles.title: Crypto Wealth Firm Nexo Sponsors $3 Million Golf Tournament at Trump International Scotland
articles.snippet: Trump International Golf Links will again host the DP World Tour's Nexo Championship, now with a $3 million prize pool.

articles.title: Trump Orders Fed to Review Crypto Firms’ Access to Master Accounts
articles.snippet: The order asks the Fed to review crypto firms’ access to payment rails, putting its control over master accounts under scrutiny.
